The factory output risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the gpt-5.2 model successfully handled the logical weighting, the 4m 49s runtime suggests potential overhead in the execution environment. Future iterations should verify that the risk-calc logic remains performant under larger datasets beyond the single trial reported.
